title: Slow-fast dynamics in a planar parasite--host model with an extinction singularity
summary: We study a slow-fast parasite--host model featuring a singularity at the extinction state. Using techniques from Geometric Singular Perturbation Theory (GSPT), and in particular the so-called blow-up method, we desingularize that point and reconstruct the local and global dynamics.
